name: said
description: The product's note beside an entry: shut until opened (details/summary, no script). The label column says "From your record"; opening rolls the label from "Read the note" to "Hide the note", turns the chevron and lets the note down. The note ends in the citation pair.

open.description: The static comps' open state (was .ccol.open): the note shown without its details.

expanded.description: The note in its shut form with its details already open (<details open>): 11-states' "The note, opened".

ariaLabel.description: The note's accessible name when it says more than the visible label. Defaults to the label. No page uses it since the Asked turn left the past day (2026-10-20).

foot.description: The note's source (button cite) and its thumbs (thumbs, form pair), always shown.

states.focus-visible: yes: the product focus ring on the summary (base)
states.disabled: n/a: a note can always be opened
states.selected: yes: open (details[open]): the label rolls, the chevron turns, the note shows
states.empty: n/a: a note always has text

events.toggle: opened or shut (the details element's own)

a11y.keyboard: Tab to the summary, Space or Enter toggles
a11y.labels: aria-label on the aside; the summary text

responsive.1200: the note and summary lose their measure

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css C4 (.said and its parts).

Option expanded: the note's details rendered open (11-states' note-open view).
